per_fold_gate.baseline: metric-wise lower loss of B0_ONE_YEAR_EB and B1_MARCEL_345_K1200
per_fold_gate.rule: candidate minus baseline must be less than -1e-8 in both metrics and both weighting views in V2023 and V2024

pooled_gate.baseline: metric-wise lower loss of B0_ONE_YEAR_EB and B1_MARCEL_345_K1200
pooled_gate.rule: candidate minus baseline must be less than -1e-8 in every metric and both weighting views

calibration_gate.surface: pooled V2023 and V2024 identical player-fold rows
calibration_gate.rule: candidate distance must be less than C0 distance by more than 1e-8 in both weighting views

supported_level_reversal_gate.support: at least 100 evaluation-overlap players and 10000 target PA in a fold-level cell
supported_level_reversal_gate.rate_reversal: woba_rmse exceeds the metric-wise strongest baseline by more than 0.002 and runs_per_600_rmse exceeds it by more than 0.5
supported_level_reversal_gate.proper_score_reversal: terminal_log_loss and terminal_brier_score each exceed their metric-wise strongest baseline by more than 0.0005
supported_level_reversal_gate.rule: neither reversal may occur for any supported level in V2023 or V2024, in either weighting view

richer_ablation_gate.surface: pooled V2023 and V2024 identical player-fold rows
richer_ablation_gate.comparators: D1 versus D0 and D2 versus D0
richer_ablation_gate.proper_scores: both terminal proper scores must improve by more than 1e-8 in both weighting views
richer_ablation_gate.rate_guardrail: woba_rmse may worsen by no more than 0.25 percent in either weighting view

selection_rule: among candidates that pass the overall gate and any required richer ablation, select the first in D0, D1, D2 simplicity order
